description: Source-informed synthetic scenario inputs for the probability adapter only. ENG is the AI actor; all stock, PP, free-factory counts, relationship arrays, state 16 owner/controller/cores, alert/contamination, and Event 026 global state are declared synthetic fixtures, not observed campaign/save facts. Event 026 arrays are explicit aligned registry values (source id 26, ratio 5000 or 2500, priority 500, eligibility mask 0) with matching active campaign state where applicable. Physical inputs enumerate all five real mask models. No new sale quote, arithmetic temporary, or callback result variable is supplied. Only one relevant recipient/state example is enumerated; world target pools are intentionally incomplete, so no click probability is inferred. Occupied distribution is an untargeted COUNTRY ROOT decision. Its one-state pool represents an ENG-controlled State 16 with owner FRA by default; it is deliberately incomplete and does not create a decision FROM target.
